characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model may pick any model in the target unit as its individual target, which is resolved as if it was a unit of [1]. Takedown attacks must be resolved before other weapons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by 3. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemies charging this unit get -1 total 'Impact' rolls per model with this rule in the two front rows if charging in the front, unless this unit is Fatigued.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Counts as both a ranged weapon and a melee weapon.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Ignores Cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When using Hold actions and shooting, may target enemies that are not in line of sight as if in line of sight, and ignores Cover from Sight Blockers.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit takes hits in melee from enemies charging it in the front, roll 3 dice per model with this rule in it, or up to as many dice as hits taken. For each 6+ one hit is ignored (defender picks which).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this unit takes hits in melee from enemies charging it in the front, roll 1 dice per model with this rule in it, or up to as many dice as hits taken. For each 6+ one hit is ignored (defender picks which).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.
